name: Orange Creamsicle Frozen Yogurt

ingredients.name: freshly squeezed orange juice, from 4 large oranges
grated orange zest, from 1 large orange
freshly squeezed lemon juice, from 1 whole lemon

instructions.primary_message: Whisk together yogurt, orange juice, zest, and sugar in a mixing bowl until sugar has completely dissolved. Add lemon juice and salt in 1/4 teaspoon increments, until flavor tastes balanced between sweet and tart. Chill in an ice bath or refrigerate until yogurt registers at least 40°F on an instant-read thermometer.
Churn yogurt in ice cream machine according to manufacturer's instructions. Transfer ice cream to airtight container and chill in freezer for at least 4 to 5 hours before serving.

schema_metadata.keywords: citrus, frozen dessert, frozen yogurt, ice cream, yogurt

description: The classic creamsicle gets an upgrade with tangy yogurt and a big jolt of orange zest to bolster the fruit's bittersweet citrus edge.
notes: Total time, including resting: 8 hr 35 min to 9 hr 35 min.
author: Max Falkowitz
